description: ORFs in all 6 frames (3 forward + 3 reverse-complement): an ORF runs from a start codon (default ATG) to the first in-frame stop codon of the NCBI genetic code genetic_code (default 1 = Standard: TAA/TAG/TGA), stop included; every in-frame start that reaches a stop is reported, so nested ORFs sharing a stop are all returned (Rosalind ORF). minLength is in nucleotides including the stop (NCBI ORFfinder's -ml excludes it: minLengthExcludesStop). position is the 0-based start in the scanned strand (the input, or its reverse complement when isReverseComplement); start/end are the 0-based inclusive input-strand coordinates. Options (NCBI ORFfinder / COrf): startCodons AtgOnly (default) | GeneticCodeStarts (ATG + the table's alternative initiation codons) | AnySenseCodon (stop-to-stop); nested=false keeps only the most upstream start per stop; includeOpenEnded adds 3'-partial ORFs that reach the sequence end without a stop (isTerminated=false); strand (both|plus|minus, as ORFfinder -strand; alternative to bothStrands=false) restricts the strands. NCBI ORFfinder 0.4.3 options, measured on the binary (1750 runs): ignoreNested (-n: drop an ORF lying completely inside another ORF of any frame or strand; identical spans: the plus-strand ORF goes), regionStart/regionEnd (-b/-e, 1-based inclusive, 0 = to the end; the region is cut out and scanned alone, start/end stay in input coordinates), orfFinderMinLength (-ml: values below 30 become 30, whole codons), allowDualCodingStopTables (-g 27/28/31). isStartPartial marks an ORF that begins within the first 3 nt of the scanned strand or region (ORFfinder '5-partial'; isTerminated=false = 3'-partial). The ORFfinder equivalent is startCodons=GeneticCodeStarts nested=false includeOpenEnded=true minLengthExcludesStop=true orfFinderMinLength=true allowDualCodingStopTables=true; -c (circular) has no effect in the binary and no counterpart here. Without allowDualCodingStopTables tables with dual-coding stops (27, 28, 31) are rejected. IUPAC input (e.g. N runs of an assembly) is accepted: an ambiguous codon ends an ORF only when every concrete codon is a stop, never starts one and is otherwise read through.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence: A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N (case-insensitive). An ambiguous codon ends an ORF only when every concrete codon is a stop, is never a start, and is otherwise read through.

minLength.description: Minimum ORF length in nucleotides, stop codon included unless minLengthExcludesStop (default 100).

genetic_code.description: NCBI translation table number whose stop codons end ORFs (default 1 = Standard; e.g. 2 = vertebrate mitochondrial, 11 = bacterial/plastid). One of the NCBI gc.prt tables (1-6, 9-16, 21-33); the dual-coding 27, 28, 31 only with allowDualCodingStopTables.

startCodons.description: Start-codon policy (case-insensitive): AtgOnly (default), GeneticCodeStarts (ATG and the alternative initiation codons of genetic_code, e.g. TTG/CTG in table 1), AnySenseCodon (any non-stop codon).

nested.description: true (default): report every in-frame start (nested ORFs). false: only the most upstream start per stop codon (NCBI ORFfinder default, EMBOSS getorf).

includeOpenEnded.description: true: also report ORFs that run to the sequence end without a stop codon (3'-partial, isTerminated=false). Default false.

minLengthExcludesStop.description: true: minLength excludes the stop codon (NCBI ORFfinder -ml / EMBOSS getorf -minsize). Default false.

bothStrands.description: true (default): scan both strands; false: forward strand only (see strand).

strand.description: NCBI ORFfinder -strand: both | plus | minus (case-insensitive). Default null = decided by bothStrands; cannot be combined with bothStrands=false.

ignoreNested.description: NCBI ORFfinder -n true: drop every ORF whose span lies completely inside another reported ORF of any frame/strand (identical spans: the plus-strand ORF is dropped). Default false.

regionStart.description: NCBI ORFfinder -b: 1-based first nucleotide of the searched region (default 1; 0 is read as 1). The region is cut out and scanned as a sequence of its own.

regionEnd.description: NCBI ORFfinder -e: 1-based last nucleotide (inclusive) of the region; 0 (default) or beyond the sequence = to the end. An end below the start is an error.

orfFinderMinLength.description: NCBI ORFfinder -ml rule: minLength below 30 is changed to 30 and used in whole codons (rounded down to a multiple of 3; also lifts the minLength >= 1 check). Default false.

allowDualCodingStopTables.description: true: genetic_code 27, 28 and 31 are accepted and the codons the table lists as stops end ORFs (what NCBI ORFfinder -g 27/28/31 does). Default false (rejected).

position.description: 0-based start in the scanned strand (input, or its reverse complement when isReverseComplement)

end.description: 0-based inclusive end in input (forward-strand) coordinates, stop codon included

isTerminated.description: false for an open-ended (no stop) ORF

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Invalid DNA sequence (A/C/G/T and IUPAC codes only)
Minimum ORF length must be at least 1
Genetic code 27/28/31 has dual-coding stop codons / unknown table / unknown startCodons
